protocol.written: before the first run (tools/audit_inject.py docstring); the audit's rules were not changed
protocol.register: public SL feed 20261006: 1688 limitations, 1624 distinct DE/FR/IT text triples
protocol.eligible: one representative per distinct triple, no baseline finding of any kind: 1597 limitations (27 triples with a baseline finding excluded)
protocol.sampling: per type and target language (fr, it): random.Random('20261010:<type>:<lang>') shuffle, first 100 with a site; one fault per copy

types.number: one number (digits or number word 2..12, followed by a unit word) changed to another plausible value
types.unit: one unit changed within its dimension, number kept (mg<->µg, g->mg, kg->g, ml->dl; days->weeks->months, months->weeks, years->months, hours->days)
types.deletion: one number-bearing sentence (text has >= 2) or comma clause (sentence has >= 2) deleted
types.language: the target field replaced by one of the two other language fields (50/50)
types.typo: one edit in the word before a number, the unit word after it, or a number word: glue (delete the space; not before a unit symbol), delete, double, substitute or transpose a letter

detection.number: number finding: new value on the target side or old value on the German side
detection.unit: unit finding for the changed value
detection.deletion: number finding with a deleted value on the German side
detection.language: language finding on the target field naming the source language
detection.typo: editorial finding whose surface is within 30 characters of the edit
detection.any: the limitation has any finding (all were finding-free before the injection)

protocol.execution: register statistics rebuilt from each modified register (audit.build_stats on the modified language), shipped terminology pairs (as --terms), audit.run_all on the copy's limitation; equivalence to a full-register run checked on the 'verification' copies

summary.note: pooled over types with equal n per type: a summary of this protocol's mix, not of real error frequencies
